lixivia.translation: n. 碱汁, 浸滤液(lixivium 的复数)

lixivial.definition:
a. Impregnated with, or consisting of, alkaline salts
   extracted from wood ashes; impregnated with a salt or salts like a
   lixivium.
a. Of the color of lye; resembling lye.
a. Having the qualities of alkaline salts extracted from
   wood ashes.
lixivial.translation: [机] 浸滤了的, 去了碱的

lixiviate.definition:
a. Alt. of Lixivited
v. t. To subject to a washing process for the purpose of
   separating soluble material from that which is insoluble; to leach, as
   ashes, for the purpose of extracting the alkaline substances.

lixiviated.translation: v. 浸出, 浸滤( lixiviate的过去式和过去分词 )

lixiviating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Lixiviate
lixiviating.translation: [化] 浸沥; 浸滤; 浸提; 去碱作用

lixiviation.definition:
n. Lixiviating; the process of separating a soluble
   substance form one that is insoluble, by washing with some solvent, as
   water; leaching.

lixivious.translation: [机] 浸滤了的, 去了碱的

lixivium.definition:
n. A solution of alkaline salts extracted from wood ashes;
   hence, any solution obtained by lixiviation.
lixivium.translation: n. 浸出液,灰汁, 碱汁

lixs.translation: (lix 的第三人称 -s形式) abbr. lixiviation 浸滤（作用）
